principles: Compare body, installed connections/clearances and operating envelope separately.
A device fitting the nominal footprint is not installation approval. Heights and actual site dimensions remain unknown.
A different size, door type or position requires a new local proposal and operation review before adoption.

appliances.label: الثلاجة

reservation.meaning: Nominal source-model reservation; not a measured installation opening or an approved product maximum.

appliances.selection_basis: Match the 650 × 650 mm nominal body reserve first; confirm actual integration type, hinge, ventilation and drawer-removal angle.

operation_evidence.interpretation: The 2 mm modeled side gap is not a manufacturer-approved hinge or ventilation clearance. Plan east/west must be matched to the actual front-view manual.

manual_fields: Total installed depth including handle and rear ventilation
Hinge reversibility and required side clearance beside panel
Opening angle needed for drawers, shelves and removal
Approved integration/niche dimensions and ventilation route

appliances.label: غسالة الأطباق

reservation.meaning: Nominal source-model reservation; not a measured installation opening or an approved product maximum.

appliances.selection_basis: Start comparison with a 60 cm integrated-module class; the 600 × 610 reservation is not the clear installation niche.

operation_evidence.terrace_passage_during_loading: NO_MODEL_ROUTE at both grids in the declared trial
operation_evidence.interpretation: Do not promise simultaneous loading and service-terrace passage.

manual_fields: Clear niche width, depth and height with adjustable feet
Water/drain/electrical connection space
Door and furniture-front projection, hinge system and plinth interference
Standing/loading position and actual terrace-passage trial

appliances.label: الغسالة

reservation.meaning: Nominal source-model reservation; not a measured installation opening or an approved product maximum.

appliances.selection_basis: Compare a front-loading candidate against the nominal 600 × 610 reserve; under-counter height, lid treatment and rear hoses require its manual.

operation_evidence.interpretation: Centered loading overlaps the open terrace leaf. The 150 mm-east stance removes that overlap but still disconnects terrace passage in the modeled stage.

manual_fields: Full closed depth including door and connections
Approved under-counter dimensions and any manufacturer-supported lid treatment
Actual door hinge, swing and loading stance
Specified side/rear installation and service clearances

appliances.label: الفرن

reservation.meaning: No separate oven object or measured oven niche. The operation study assumes an under-hob oven in the west counter.

appliances.selection_basis: Confirm whether an under-hob oven is wanted before matching cabinet, support and services.

operation_evidence.interpretation: Oven/operator trial admits service passage; simultaneous open dishwasher overlaps that operator. These are assumed envelopes.

manual_fields: Actual installation niche dimensions and support
Total open-door projection and standing position
Compatibility and clearances with the selected hob
Electrical/services and ventilation requirements from the product manual

appliances.label: الموقد والشفاط

reservation.meaning: Nominal source-model reservation; not a measured installation opening or an approved product maximum.

appliances.selection_basis: The 600 × 400 hob is a drawing placeholder. Match a real hob and hood using their installation drawings; the placeholder is not a worktop cutout.

operation_evidence.interpretation: Gas hob concept; hood/exhaust and heat clearances remain unresolved.

manual_fields: Hob overall dimensions and manufacturer worktop cutout
Worktop depth/thickness and edge clearances
Hob/oven compatibility and nearby upper-cabinet clearances
Hood width, installation height and exhaust route for the selected products
